newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: No Ranariddh plan to attend ASEAN meeting.
newsitem.headline: No Ranariddh plan to attend ASEAN meeting.

text.p: Ousted Cambodian first prime minister Prince Norodom Ranariddh does not plan to go to Kuala Lumpur for the ASEAN annual meetings this week, an official with his delegation said on Monday.

"No, he won't be going there," the official said when asked if Ranariddh, whose forces were beaten in fighting with troops loyal to co-prime minister Hun Sen early this month, would attend the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN meetings.
She said Ranariddh planned to stay in Singapore until Wednesday and then return to Bangkok, where he met foreign ministers from the Association of Southeast Asian Nations last week.
He had discussions with Singapore Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong on Monday, but has no other meetings set yet in his drive to seek support from regional leaders, the official said.

Neither side offered details of the meeting. Singapore issued a brief statement saying Ranariddh had briefed Goh on recent developments in Cambodia and that Goh had expressed his regret over the recent crisis.
Cambodia was in line to have joined ASEAN at this week's Kuala Lumpur meeting. But Hun Sen's bloody coup against his co-premier earlier this month has put that on hold.
